function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if v_u_20 then
		v_u_20:Disconnect()
		v_u_20 = nil

		v_u_21:Disconnect()
		v_u_21 = nil

	if v_u_22 then
		v_u_22:Disconnect()
		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor
	v_u_20 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)
		if p31 == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

	local v_u_45 = true

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43

			local v60 = v53.ChildAdded
			table.insert(v59, v60:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
			local v61 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v62 = v53.ChildRemoved
			table.insert(v61, v62:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)

	if v_u_17[p_u_42].count <= 0 then

end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v102 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v102 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v102
end
local function v_u_108(p103) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14
	local v104 = p103 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v105 = 0.0001
	local v106 = 0.0001
	local v107 = 1
	if v104 <= 0.5 then
		v107 = v104 / 0.5
		v105 = 1
	elseif v104 < 1 then
		v106 = (v104 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v105 = 1 - v106
	else
		v107 = v104 / 1
		v106 = 1
	end
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v105)
	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v106)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v107)
	v_u_14:AdjustSpeed(v107)
end

function rollAnimation(p114) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v115 = math.random(1, v_u_17[p114].totalWeight)
	local v116 = 1
	while v_u_17[p114][v116].weight < v115 do
		v115 = v115 - v_u_17[p114][v116].weight
		v116 = v116 + 1
	end
	return v116
end

end

				v_u_40 = nil

			v_u_29.Bottom.Main.Visible = true
		end

					task.cancel(v_u_35)

			end
		end
		return
	end
end

local function v_u_76(p62, p63, p_u_64) -- name: buildOddsEntries

function v_u_54.renderItemsInCrafting(p171) -- name: renderItemsInCrafting
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_34, (copy) v_u_42, (copy) v_u_46, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_8
	if v_u_43 then
		task.cancel(v_u_43)
		v_u_43 = nil
	end
	if p171 then
		return
	elseif v_u_34.Visible then
		local v_u_172 = v_u_42.ItemPreview
		v_u_43 = task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_46, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_172, (ref) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_43
			local v173 = {}
			for v174, v175 in v_u_46.Odds do
				if v175 <= 0 then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(v173, v174)
			end
			table.sort(v173, function(p176, p177)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_12
				return v_u_12.getTierIndex(p176) < v_u_12.getTierIndex(p177)
			end)
			if #v173 <= 0 then
				v_u_172.Image = v_u_26.getRarityImage("Common")
				v_u_172.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_8.DefaultKnife.Image
				v_u_43 = nil
				return
			end
			local v178 = 1
			while true do
				local v179 = v173[v178]
				local v180 = v_u_12.getItemsForRarity(v179)
				if v180 and #v180 > 0 then
					local v181 = v_u_8[v180[Random.new():NextInteger(1, #v180)]]
					if not v181 then
						continue
					end
					v_u_172.ImageLabel.Image = v181.Image

function v_u_45.manageSelectionRender(p208) -- name: manageSelectionRender
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_45
	if v_u_36 then
		if v_u_36.Trove then
			v_u_36.Trove:Destroy()
			v_u_36.Trove = nil
		end
		for v209, _ in v_u_36.Tweens do
			v_u_36.Tweens[v209]:Cancel()
			v_u_36.Tweens[v209]:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(v_u_36.Tweens)
	end
	if p208 then
		v_u_36 = nil
	else
		v_u_36 = {
			["Trove"] = nil,
			["Selecting"] = nil,
			["Tweens"] = nil,
			["Trove"] = v_u_19.new(),
			["Tweens"] = {}
		}
		local v210 = v_u_22.getInput()
		if v210 == "KeyboardAndMouse" then
			return v_u_45.renderSelectionForPc()
		end
		if v210 == "Gamepad" then
			return v_u_45.renderSelectionForConsole()
		end
		if v210 == "Touch" then
			return v_u_45.renderSelectionForMobile()
		end
	end
end

				end
				v_u_39[v241] = {

				v238.Visible = false

				v244:PivotTo(v243.WorldModelCFrameInWheel or CFrame.new(21, 3, 100))

				local v246 = v243.Timeline[v243.PreviewTimeline or 1]
				local v247 = v244:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if v247 then

					v247.AutoRotate = false

				end

					["Name"] = v234[v241]

				end
				v_u_39[v241].Track = v250
			else

				local v253 = v_u_26:TryIndex({ "BoughtEmotePages" }) or 0

			end
		end
		if v_u_36 then
			if v_u_37 then
				local v255 = v_u_36.Selecting
				if typeof(v255) == "number" then
					v255 = (v_u_34 - 1) * 8 + v255
				end
				local v256 = v234[v255 or 0] or "None"
				local v257 = v256 == "" and "None" or v256
				v_u_28.Frame.Wheel.EmoteName.Text = ("%*%*"):format(v_u_29.Enabled and "Replacing: " or "", v257)
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_45.updateInventoryCulling() -- name: updateInventoryCulling
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_38
	local v258 = v_u_29:FindFirstChild("Frame")
	local v259
	if v258 then
		v259 = v258:FindFirstChild("ItemsHolderFrame")
	else
		v259 = v258
	end
	if v258 and v259 then
		local v260 = v_u_29.Enabled
		if v260 then
			v260 = v258.Visible
		end
		if not v260 or v259.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
			local v261 = v259.AbsolutePosition.Y - 32
			local v262 = v261 + v259.AbsoluteSize.Y + 64
			for _, v263 in v_u_38 do
				local v264 = v263.Viewport
				if not v264 then
					continue
				end
				local v265 = v263.Template.Parent
				local v266 = v265.AbsolutePosition.Y
				local v267 = v260 and v265.Visible
				if v267 then
					if v261 < v266 + v265.AbsoluteSize.Y then
						v267 = v266 < v262
					else
						v267 = false
					end
				end
				if v264.Visible ~= v267 then
					v264.Visible = v267
				end
				if v263.Track.IsPlaying ~= v267 then
					if v267 then
						v263.Track:Play()
					else
						v263.Track:Stop()
					end
				end
				local v268 = v263.PropTracks
				if not v268 then
					continue
				end
				for _, v269 in v268 do
					if v269.IsPlaying == v267 then
						continue
					end
					if v267 then
						v269:Play()
					else
						v269:Stop()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_45.toggleHudPage(p321) -- name: toggleHudPage
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_34, (copy) v_u_121, (copy) v_u_45, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_28
	if v_u_36 then
		local v322 = v_u_26:TryIndex({ "BoughtEmotePages" }) or 0
		local v323 = v_u_18.MaxBuyablePages
		local v324 = math.min(v323, v322) + v_u_18.MaxEmotePages + ((v_u_26:TryIndex({ "BoughtEmotePages" }) or 0) < v_u_18.MaxBuyablePages and 1 or 0)
		if p321 then
			if v324 < v_u_34 + 1 then
				return
			end
			v_u_34 = v_u_34 + 1
		else
			if v_u_34 <= 1 then
				return
			end
			local v325 = v_u_34 - 1
			v_u_34 = math.max(1, v325)
		end
		v_u_121()
		v_u_45.setupRigsInEmotesHud(nil, true)
		local v326 = {
			["MiddleIcon"] = nil,
			["Pointer"] = nil,
			["SelectIcon"] = nil,
			["OldIndex"] = -1,
			["Activated"] = true,
			["MiddleIcon"] = v_u_22.findObject(v_u_28, { "Frame", "Wheel", "Middle" }),
			["Pointer"] = v_u_22.findObject(v_u_28, {
				"Frame",
				"Wheel",
				"Middle",
				"Pointer"
			}),
			["SelectIcon"] = v_u_22.findObject(v_u_28, { "Frame", "Wheel", "Selected" })
		}
		v_u_45.selectEmoteIndex(v326)
	end
end

			end

		end

	end

local function v_u_210() -- name: queueRanked
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_89, (ref) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_46, (copy) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_30
	if v_u_5.isInGame(v_u_28) then
		v_u_15.Error({
			["text"] = "You can\'t queue while in a match."
		})
		return
	else
		local v201 = v_u_28:GetAttribute("PartyLeaderId")
		if v201 == nil and true or v201 == v_u_28.UserId then
			if v_u_14.RankedEnabled:Get() then
				local v202 = v_u_4.PlayerData:TryIndex({ "Wins" })
				if typeof(v202) == "number" then
					local v203 = v_u_14.RankedWinThreshold:Get()
					if v202 < v203 then
						v_u_15.Error({
							["text"] = ("You need %* wins to play Ranked."):format(v203)
						})
						return
					else
						local v204 = v_u_4.PlayerData:TryIndex({ "Elo", "LeaverPenaltyUntil" })
						if typeof(v204) == "number" and os.time() < v204 then
							local v205 = (v204 - os.time()) / 60
							local v206 = math.ceil(v205)
							local v207 = v206 == 1 and "minute" or "minutes"
							v_u_15.Error({
								["text"] = ("You left a Ranked match. You can queue again in %* %*."):format(v206, v207)
							})
							return
						else
							local v208 = #v_u_89()
							if table.find(v_u_14.MatchmakingModes:Get(), v_u_65) then
								local v209 = v_u_46[v_u_65]
								if v209 < v208 then
									v_u_15.Error({
										["text"] = ("This queue supports parties of up to %*."):format(v209)
									})
								else
									v_u_31:Play()
									v_u_4.PlayerGui.Matchmaking.SearchingForMatch:SetAttribute("ModeOverride", (string.gsub(v_u_65, "_", " ")))
									v_u_30:FireServer("play", {
										["mode"] = v_u_65
									})
								end
							else
								v_u_15.Error({
									["text"] = "That matchmaking queue is unavailable."
								})
								return
							end
						end
					end
				else
					v_u_15.Error({
						["text"] = "Ranked data is still loading. Please try again."
					})
					return
				end
			else
				v_u_15.Error({
					["text"] = "Ranked is currently disabled. Please try again later."
				})
				return
			end
		else
			v_u_15.Error({
				["text"] = "Only the party leader can start matchmaking."
			})
			return
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_355(p334) -- name: getRankProgress
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_61, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_62, (copy) v_u_37
	local v335 = v_u_61()
	local v336
	if v335.placements < 5 then
		v336 = 0
	else
		local v337 = v_u_17.getRankTier(v335.elo, v_u_62())
		if v337 then
			local v338 = v337.Name
			v336 = table.find(v_u_37, v338) or 0
		else
			v336 = 0
		end
	end
	local v339 = #p334
	local v340 = math.min(v336, v339)
	if v340 <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local v341 = p334[v340]
	local v342 = p334[v340 + 1]
	if not v342 then
		return v341
	end
	local v343 = v_u_17.EloRange[v340]
	local v344 = v_u_17.EloRange[v340 + 1]
	if not v343 or (not v344 or v344.Top100Only) then
		return v341
	end
	local v345 = v343.Min + 1000
	local v346 = math.round(v345)
	local v347 = math.max(0, v346)
	local v348 = v344.Min + 1000
	local v349 = math.round(v348)
	local v350 = math.max(0, v349) - v347
	if v350 <= 0 then
		return v341
	end
	local v351 = v_u_61().elo + 1000
	local v352 = math.round(v351)
	local v353 = (math.max(0, v352) - v347) / v350
	local v354 = math.clamp(v353, 0, 1)
	return v341 + (v342 - v341) * v354
end

local function v_u_287(p278, p279) -- name: evaluateCoding
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_16
	local v280 = p278.decode
	local v281 = p278.config
	if p279 - v280.lastEvalAt < v281.MetricsInterval then
		return
	else
		v280.lastEvalAt = p279
		local v282 = 0
		for _, v283 in p278.workers do
			local v284 = v283.metrics
			if not v284 then
				continue
			end
			v282 = v282 + (v284.decodeMs or 0)
		end

					return

				if v280.strikes >= v281.DecodeBudgetSamples then
					v280.coding = v_u_13.CODING_FLAT
					v280.strikes = 0
					v280.fallbacks = v280.fallbacks + 1
					v280.fellBackAt = p279
					v_u_16((("decode %* ms/frame over the %* ms budget; falling back to flat coding for %* s"):format(string.format("%.2f", v280.combinedMs), v281.DecodeBudgetMs, v280.retryAfter)))
					return
				end
			elseif p279 - v280.fellBackAt >= v280.retryAfter then
				local v285 = v280.retryAfter * 2
				local v286 = v281.DecodeRetryMaxSeconds
				v280.retryAfter = math.min(v285, v286)

				v280.strikes = 0

			end
		end
	end
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_277, (copy) v_u_287, (copy) v_u_214, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_85, (copy) v_u_134, (copy) v_u_140, (copy) v_u_182

			end
		end
		v289.cache:prune(v290)

			end
		end
		v_u_182(v289, v290)

end

		end

	end

		end

			v304.A = v299
			v304.B = v300

		else

	local v312

function v_u_67._flushGroups(p357) -- name: _flushGroups

function v_u_67._writeMotion(p376, p377, p378, p379, p380, p381) -- name: _writeMotion
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7
	p376.Sampled[p377] = true
	local v382 = p376.Samples[p377]
	local v383
	if v382 then
		v383 = v382.T
	else
		v383 = v382
	end
	local v384
	if v382 then
		v384 = v382.CFrame
	else
		v384 = v382
	end
	local v385
	if v382 then
		v385 = v382.BeforeT
	else
		v385 = v382
	end
	local v386
	if v382 then
		v386 = v382.Before
	else
		v386 = v382
	end
	if v382 then
		local v387 = v382.T
		local v388 = v382.CFrame
		v382.BeforeT = v387
		v382.Before = v388
		v382.T = p381
		v382.CFrame = p380
	else
		p376.Samples[p377] = {
			["T"] = p381,
			["CFrame"] = p380
		}
	end
	local v389 = p376.Motions[p377]
	local v390
	if v389 then
		local v391
		if p381 < v389.T then
			v391 = false
		else
			local v392 = v_u_9.at(v389.Base, v389.W, v389.V, v389.A, (p381 - v389.T) / 1000)
			v391 = not v_u_9.apart(v392, p380, 0.2, 0.02)
		end
		if v391 then
			v389.Hits = v389.Hits + 1
			return true, false
		end
		p376.Motions[p377] = nil
		v390 = true
		if v389.Hits == 0 then
			p376.Untrusted[p377] = true
		end
	else
		v390 = false
	end
	if not v384 or (not v383 or (p381 <= v383 or p381 - v383 > 250)) then
		p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
		return false, v390
	end
	local v393, v394 = v_u_9.between(v384, p380, (p381 - v383) / 1000)
	local v395 = v393.Magnitude < 0.002 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v393
	if v394.Magnitude < 0.02 and v395 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
		p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
		return false, v390
	end
	local v396 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local v397, v398
	if v395 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) and (v386 and (v385 and (v385 < v383 and v383 - v385 <= 250))) then
		v397, v398 = v_u_9.accelerating(v386.Position, v384.Position, p380.Position, v385 / 1000, v383 / 1000, p381 / 1000)
		if v398.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			v398 = v396
			v397 = v394
		end
	else
		v398 = v396
		v397 = v394
	end
	local v399 = {
		["PropId"] = nil,
		["T"] = nil,
		["Base"] = nil,
		["W"] = nil,
		["V"] = nil,
		["A"] = nil,
		["Hits"] = 0,
		["PropId"] = p379,
		["T"] = p381,
		["Base"] = p380,
		["W"] = v395,
		["V"] = v397,
		["A"] = v398
	}
	local v400
	if not p376.Untrusted[p377] then
		p376.Motions[p377] = v399
		v404, v405, v406, v407 = v_u_7.quantizeRotation(p380)
		v408 = p376.SentCFrames[p377]
		if not v408 then
			v408 = {}
			p376.SentCFrames[p377] = v408
		end
		v409 = v408[p379]
		if v409 == nil or (v409.K ~= v404 or (v409.A ~= v405 or v409.B ~= v406)) then
			v400 = false
		else
			v400 = v409.C == v407
		end
		v408[p379] = {
			["Position"] = p380.Position,
			["K"] = v404,
			["A"] = v405,
			["B"] = v406,
			["C"] = v407
		}
		v410 = p376.Stream
		v410:Time(p381)
		v_u_9.write(v410.W, p378, p379, p380, v395, v397, v398, v400)
		v410:EndRecord()
		v411 = p376.LastSent[p377]
		if v411 then
			v411[p379] = p381
		end
		return true, v390
	end
	local v401 = p376.Candidates[p377]
	p376.Candidates[p377] = v399
	if not v401 then
		return false, v390
	end
	local v402
	if p381 < v401.T then
		v402 = false
	else
		local v403 = v_u_9.at(v401.Base, v401.W, v401.V, v401.A, (p381 - v401.T) / 1000)
		v402 = not v_u_9.apart(v403, p380, 0.2, 0.02)
	end
	if not v402 then
		return false, v390
	end
	p376.Untrusted[p377] = nil
	p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
	p376.Motions[p377] = v399
	local v404, v405, v406, v407 = v_u_7.quantizeRotation(p380)
	local v408 = p376.SentCFrames[p377]
	if not v408 then
		v408 = {}
		p376.SentCFrames[p377] = v408
	end
	local v409 = v408[p379]
	if v409 == nil or (v409.K ~= v404 or (v409.A ~= v405 or v409.B ~= v406)) then
		v400 = false
	else
		v400 = v409.C == v407
	end
	v408[p379] = {
		["Position"] = p380.Position,
		["K"] = v404,
		["A"] = v405,
		["B"] = v406,
		["C"] = v407
	}
	local v410 = p376.Stream
	v410:Time(p381)
	v_u_9.write(v410.W, p378, p379, p380, v395, v397, v398, v400)
	v410:EndRecord()
	local v411 = p376.LastSent[p377]
	if v411 then
		v411[p379] = p381
	end
	return true, v390
end
function v_u_67._checkMotions(p412) -- name: _checkMotions
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28
	local v413 = p412.Clock()
	local v414 = {}
	for v415 in p412.Motions do
		if p412.Sampled[v415] then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v414, v415)
	end
	for _, v416 in v414 do
		local v417 = p412.Motions[v416]
		local v418 = p412.Ids[v416]
		if v418 then
			local v419 = v_u_28(v416, "CFrame")
			p412.LastCFrame[v416] = v419
			p412:_writeProp(v416, v418, v417.PropId, v419, v413)
		else
			p412.Motions[v416] = nil
		end
	end
	table.clear(p412.Sampled)
end

function v_u_67._untrack(p424, p425) -- name: _untrack
	local v426 = p424.Kinds[p425]
	if v426 == "joint" or (v426 == "weld" or v426 == "constraint") then
		local v427 = p424.JointParts[p425]
		if v427 then
			p424:_checkRoots(v427[1], v427[2], p424.Clock())
		end
		p424:_setJointParts(p425, nil, nil)
	end
	if p424.Ids[p425] then
		p424.Count = p424.Count - 1
	end
	p424.Registry:Free(p425)
	p424.Registry:NotifyUntracked(p425)
	p424.Kinds[p425] = nil
	p424.Roots[p425] = nil
	p424.RootOf[p425] = nil
	p424.JointParts[p425] = nil
	p424.Held[p425] = nil

	p424.Baked[p425] = nil
	p424.BakedMemo[p425] = nil
	p424.LastCFrame[p425] = nil
	p424.LastSent[p425] = nil
	p424.SeqStates[p425] = nil
	p424.SentCFrames[p425] = nil
	p424.Motions[p425] = nil
	p424.Samples[p425] = nil
	p424.Candidates[p425] = nil
	p424.Untrusted[p425] = nil
	p424.WorldPoll.Set[p425] = nil
	p424:_setPlayerPolled(p425, nil)
	p424.DirtyProps[p425] = nil
	p424.DirtyName[p425] = nil
	for _, v428 in { p424.Signals, p424.AttachSignals } do
		local v429 = v428[p425]
		if not v429 then
			continue
		end
		for _, v430 in v429 do
			v430:Disconnect()
		end
		v428[p425] = nil
	end
end
function v_u_67._untrackTree(p431, p432, p433) -- name: _untrackTree
	local v434
	if p433 then
		local v435 = p431.Kids[p433]
		if v435 then
			v435[p432] = nil
			v434 = { p432 }
		else
			v434 = { p432 }
		end
	else
		v434 = { p432 }
	end
	while #v434 > 0 do
		local v436 = table.remove(v434)
		local v437 = p431.Kids[v436]
		if v437 then
			for v438 in v437 do
				table.insert(v434, v438)
			end
			p431.Kids[v436] = nil
		end
		p431:_untrack(v436)
	end
end
function v_u_67._watchFiltered(p_u_439, p_u_440) -- name: _watchFiltered
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66
	p_u_439.Registry:WatchFiltered(p_u_440, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_439, (copy) p_u_440, (ref) v_u_66
		if not p_u_439.Destroyed then
			local v441 = p_u_439.Clock()
			p_u_439.DirtyStructure[p_u_440] = v441
			for _, v442 in p_u_440:GetDescendants() do
				if not v_u_66(v442) then
					continue
				end
				p_u_439.DirtyStructure[v442] = v441
			end
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_67._discover(p443, p444, p445) -- name: _discover
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66, (ref) v_u_28
	local v446 = v_u_66(p444)
	if v446 == "gui" then
		if not p443:_inBaked(v_u_28(p444, "Parent")) then
			p443.TrackGui(p444)
			return
		end
	else
		if v446 == "baked" and not p443.BakeModels then
			return
		end
		if v446 or p443.Particles[p444] then
			p443:_track(p444, p445)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_67._mark(p447, p448) -- name: _mark
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66, (ref) v_u_28
	local v449 = p448:IsA("Animator")
	if (v449 or v_u_66(p448)) and not p447:_hiddenByBake(p448, v_u_28(p448, "Parent")) then
		if v449 then
			p447.WatchAnimator(p448)
		else
			p447.DirtyStructure[p448] = p447.Clock()
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_67._walk(p450, p451) -- name: _walk
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28
	local v452 = p450.Registry
	local v453 = p450.Pending
	while #v453 > 0 do
		if p451 <= os.clock() then
			return false
		end
		local v454 = table.remove(v453)
		local v455 = v_u_28(v454, "Parent")
		if v455 == nil then
			continue
		end
		if v452:MatchFilter(v454, v455) then
			p450:_watchFiltered(v454)
		else
			p450:_discover(v454, p450.Clock())

function v_u_67._releaseParticleHost(p549, p550) -- name: _releaseParticleHost
	local v551 = p549.ParticleHosts[p550]

			p549.ParticleHosts[p550] = nil

				p549:_unpin(p550)
			end

	end
end

function v_u_67.WriteEmit(p567, p568, p569, p570) -- name: WriteEmit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7
	if p567.Destroyed or not p567:_inDomain(p568) then
		return false
	end
	local v571 = p567.Registry
	local v572 = v571.NextId
	local v573 = {}
	local v574
	if p567:_inBaked(p568) then
		while p568 and (p568 ~= workspace and not p567:_isBakedRoot(p568)) do
			local v575 = p568.Name
			table.insert(v573, 1, v575)
			p568 = p568.Parent
		end
		if p568 == nil or p568 == workspace then
			return false
		end

	else
		p567:AddParticle(p568)
		v574 = p567.Ids[p568] or p567:_track(p568, p570)
	end
	if not v574 then
		return false
	end
	if v572 <= v574 then
		local v576 = v571.AddFloor
		p570 = math.max(p570, v576)
	end
	local v577 = p567.Stream
	v577:Time(p570)
	local v578 = v577.W
	v578:u8(v_u_11.Emit)
	v_u_7.varuint(v578, v574)
	v_u_7.varuint(v578, p569)
	v_u_7.varuint(v578, #v573)
	for _, v579 in v573 do
		v_u_7.str(v578, v579)
	end
	v577:EndRecord()
	return true
end
function v_u_67.Snapshot(p_u_580) -- name: Snapshot
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if p_u_580.Scoped then
		local v581 = p_u_580.Registry:FilterRoot(workspace)
		if v581 then
			p_u_580:_watchPath(workspace, v581)

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_580

		end))

			table.insert(v586, v585)
		end

	local function v588(p587) -- name: markSky
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_580
		if p587:IsA("Sky") then
			p_u_580.DirtyStructure[p587] = p_u_580.Clock()
		end
	end
	local v589 = p_u_580.Connections
	local v590 = v_u_2.ChildAdded
	table.insert(v589, v590:Connect(v588))
	local v591 = p_u_580.Connections
	local v592 = v_u_2.ChildRemoved
	table.insert(v591, v592:Connect(v588))
	local v593 = p_u_580.Clock()
	for _, v594 in v_u_2:GetChildren() do
		if not v594:IsA("Sky") then
			continue
		end
		p_u_580:_track(v594, v593)
	end
	if not p_u_580:_walk(os.clock() + 0.002) then

		if not p_u_580.Destroyed then

		end
	end
end
function v_u_67._flushStructure(p595) -- name: _flushStructure
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7
	local v596 = p595.Stream
	local v597 = p595.Ids
	local v_u_598 = p595.DirtyStructure
	p595.DirtyStructure = {}
	local v599 = p595.Registry
	local v600 = {}
	local v601 = {}
	local v602 = {}
	local v603 = {}
	for v604 in v_u_598 do
		local v605 = v597[v604]
		if not (v605 and p595.Signals[v604]) then
			continue
		end
		local v606 = v_u_28(v604, "Parent")
		if v606 == nil or (not p595:_inDomain(v604) or (p595:_hiddenByBake(v604, v606) or p595.Kinds[v604] == "particle" and not p595.Particles[v604])) then
			v600[v605] = true
			table.insert(v601, v604)
		else
			if v599.FilterAny then
				local v607 = {}
				if v599:Rematch(v604, v606, p595.Kids, v607) then
					table.insert(v607, v604)
				end
				for _, v608 in v607 do
					v603[v608] = v_u_598[v604]
				end
			end
			if v603[v604] then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(v602, v604)
		end
	end
	for v609 in v603 do
		v600[v597[v609]] = true
		table.insert(v601, v609)
		p595:_watchFiltered(v609)
	end
	for _, v610 in v601 do
		local v611 = v597[v610]
		if not v611 then
			continue
		end
		local v612 = p595.Registry.ParentIds[v610]
		if not v600[v612] then
			v596:Time(v_u_598[v610] or v603[v610])
			local v613 = v596.W
			v613:u8(v_u_11.Remove)
			v_u_7.varuint(v613, v611)
			v596:EndRecord()
		end
		p595:_untrackTree(v610, p595.Registry.ById[v612])
	end
	for _, v614 in v602 do
		local v615 = v597[v614]
		if not v615 then
			continue
		end
		local v616 = v_u_598[v614]
		local v617 = v_u_28(v614, "Parent")
		local v618 = p595:_parentIdOf(v614, v617, v616)
		local v619 = p595.Registry.ParentIds[v614]
		if v618 == nil then
			v596:Time(v616)
			local v620 = v596.W
			v620:u8(v_u_11.Remove)
			v_u_7.varuint(v620, v615)
			v596:EndRecord()
			p595:_untrackTree(v614, p595.Registry.ById[v619])
		else
			if v618 == v619 then
				continue
			end
			p595.Registry.ParentIds[v614] = v618
			local v621 = p595.Registry.ById[v619]
			if v621 then
				v621 = p595.Kids[v621]
			end
			if v621 then
				v621[v614] = nil
			end
			p595:_kidsOf(v617)[v614] = true
			local v622 = p595.Registry.AddFloor
			v596:Time((math.max(v616, v622)))
			local v623 = v596.W
			v623:u8(v_u_11.Reparent)
			v_u_7.varuint(v623, v615)
			v_u_7.varuint(v623, v618)
			v596:EndRecord()
			p595:_updateInCharacter(v614)
			if not p595.Roots[v614] then
				continue
			end
			p595:_updatePolling(v614)
		end
	end
	local v624 = {}
	for v625 in v_u_598 do
		if v597[v625] then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v624, v625)
	end
	table.sort(v624, function(p626, p627)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_598
		return v_u_598[p626] < v_u_598[p627]
	end)
	local v628 = os.clock() + 0.0015
	for v629, v630 in v624 do
		if v628 <= os.clock() then
			local v631 = p595.DirtyStructure
			for v632 = v629, #v624 do
				local v633 = v624[v632]
				if v631[v633] ~= nil then
					continue
				end
				v631[v633] = v_u_598[v633]
			end
			return
		end
		if v_u_28(v630, "Parent") == nil then
			continue
		end
		p595:_discover(v630, v_u_598[v630])
	end
end
function v_u_67._flushRoots(p634) -- name: _flushRoots
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_14
	local v635 = p634.RootCheck
	p634.RootCheck = {}
	local v636 = p634.Ids
	while next(v635) do
		local v637 = {}
		v635 = v637
		for v638, v639 in v635 do
			local v640 = v636[v638]
			if v640 and p634.Kinds[v638] == "part" then
				local v641 = v_u_28
				local v642, v643 = pcall(v641, v638, "AssemblyRootPart")
				if v642 then
					if v643 then
						if v643 ~= v638 and (p634.RootOf[v638] ~= v643 and not v635[v643]) then
							v635[v643] = v639
						end
						p634.RootOf[v638] = v643
					end
					local v644 = p634:_isRecordedRoot(v638, v643)
					if v644 == (p634.Roots[v638] == true) then
						v637 = v635
					else
						p634.Roots[v638] = v644
						local v645 = v_u_28(v638, "ClassName")
						local v646 = p634:_propId(v645, v_u_14)
						if v646 then
							p634:_writeProp(v638, v640, v646, v644, v639)
						end
						if v644 then
							local v647 = p634:_propId(v645, "CFrame")
							local v648 = v_u_28(v638, "CFrame")
							if v647 and p634.LastCFrame[v638] ~= v648 then
								p634.LastCFrame[v638] = v648
								p634:_writeProp(v638, v640, v647, v648, v639)
							end
						end
						p634:_updatePolling(v638)
						v637 = v635
					end
				else
					v637 = v635
				end
			else
				v637 = v635
			end
			v635 = v637
		end
